_why: A position with no borrow, where there is no health factor to state. A report that correctly says so must not be failed for the missing figure, and one that invents a ratio must not be passed.
attribution: Synthetic throughout, written for this test suite. No agent delivered the report and it is not the work of any external builder.

chain.note: No part of this chain state is real. The captured position carries debt, so a no-borrow case cannot be derived from it. The account, block number, block hash and figures below are placeholders chosen to be unmistakably synthetic — the account is a padded placeholder, block 900,000,001 is far beyond BNB Smart Chain's head, and the hash is a repeating pattern. This position has never existed on any chain, and nothing here may be read as a statement about BNB Smart Chain.

legs._note: One supplied market and no borrowed market, which is what makes the health factor undefined.

report._fixture: Synthetic ProofRun fixture. Not a delivery by any agent.
report.protocol: Venus Core Pool, BNB Smart Chain mainnet
report.summary: Supplies collateral and borrows nothing, so there is no health factor and nothing can be liquidated.

expect._theDollarsAreCompared: This fixture was the one that found the no-debt branch returning before the dollar rows were built: position.debt_usd and position.collateral_usd were recorded and never compared, so no zero-debt position could reach verified however right the report was. Fixed in the core; the suite now proves both rows are judged, and that a wrong collateral figure here fails rather than being excused by the absent ratio.
expect._alsoProves: The inverse must fail: the same state against a report that states a health factor is a disagreement the report earned, because with no debt there is no ratio to give.
